messages:
Nora: Quick heads-up from QA: PR 5632 preview shows the console gallery out of order and several tracing examples still use `traceid` or `trace_id`. Preview only, local mkdocs looks fine.
Diego: Oof. Which gallery images are wrong? Could be the filename normalization run from the housekeeping job.
Nora: The markdown lists three images but Netlify rendered them as p95, threshold, then cost (wrong order). Branch has files renamed to underscores: `console_p95_v1.png` instead of `console-p95-v1.png`. Netlify sorts lexicographically and that changed the order.
Sam: Also saw dropped widget hydration: Netlify logs show `AttributeRemoved: data-widget-id` from sanitizer. That explains why some embeds render as code blocks.
doc-ci: Preview deploy failed: PR 5632 branch 'docs/gallery-fix' deploy 34022 -> https://app.netlify.com/sites/redwood-docs/deploys/34022/logs (Missing data-widget-id)
Nora: Plan proposal: 1) revert the housekeeping rename on the preview branch to restore ordering; 2) add a docs-lint GH Action that validates image refs exist and warns on underscores in filenames; 3) update mkdocs sanitizer allowlist for `data-widget-id` and `data-src`; 4) Sam to sweep docs for `traceid|trace_id` and replace with canonical `trace_id_hex`.
Diego: I can do step 2. I'll add an action that parses markdown, finds image refs, checks file existence, and emits a non-blocking warning on first rollout. Make it strict after a week.
Sam: I'll open a tiny PR to update snippets across JS/Python/Go. Example diff I'll include:```diff
- await client.trace({ trace_id: 'abcd' })
+ await client.trace({ trace_id_hex: '0xabcd' })
```
Nora: Good. Also add a short migration blurb at the top of tracing.md saying "If you upgraded SDKs, use trace_id_hex (hex-encoded) instead of trace_id/traceid. See SDK changelogs." Keep it 1-2 sentences.
doc-ci: Link-checker: broken anchor found in PR 5632 -> /sdk/js/CHANGELOG#v2.1. Fixing anchor will be required.
Diego: For sanitizer, I'll add an mkdocs extension patch that allows `data-widget-id` and `data-src`. I'll test locally and run a preview. If that's flaky, we revert the sanitizer bump on the branch until infra approves.
Sam: I'll also grep for variants: `git grep -n "\btraceid\b\|\btrace_id\b" docs || true` and paste hits in the PR description so reviewers can see the full sweep.
Nora: One more minor: cost vs latency captions were swapped in the gallery text. I updated the caption to explicit labels ("p95 latency heatmap", "cost breakdown (per-token)") so even if order is wrong it's clearer.
infra-bot: Created issue infra#docs-image-lint and added `docs-image-check` job to the docs workflow.
support: Noted. We'll prep a short support reply template: "If you upgraded recently, check SDK versions and use trace_id_hex; see migration note in tracing docs." We'll monitor tickets after the docs cutover.
Nora: Action items: docs#5632/revert-housekeeping (Nora), infra#docs-image-lint (Diego), docs#traceid-sweep (Sam), mkdocs#allowlist-data-attrs (Diego). Re-open preview once lint + sanitizer patch land. Thanks all.
